title: Deshaun Watson attempts to mend fences, but doesn't apologize to Browns fan base that he chastised for booing him: 'I understand the frustration'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Deshaun Watson attempts to mend fences, but doesn't apologize to Browns fan base that he chastised for booing him: 'I understand the frustration'
sources.description: Hours after being named Cleveland's starter, Watson made an effort to repair the relationship with a fan base that does not want him.
